examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The console chrome around a list page: navigation as data with a drill level and a Preview badge, the breadcrumb, Create and Agent in the actions slot (icon-only while compact), recent resources in the ⌘K palette and the account menu. The page body is only the slot content.

examples.name: PageOpensSearch
examples.summary: A page inside the layout opens the shared ⌘K palette from its own button with `useConsoleLayout().openSearch()`; it never mounts a second palette.
